verdict.rationale: Lever exposes a REST API, webhooks, and OAuth that could be scripted headlessly to create applications or react to events (lever-docs-1, lever-docs-18, lever-docs-19, lever-docs-33), but there is no documentation of a CLI, CI/CD integration, or explicit headless/automation-in-pipeline usage pattern. missing for 10: CLI tool, CI pipeline examples, explicit headless-mode documentation, independent evidence of running Lever automation in CI.
